answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through hardware attestation. Agents execute in secure enclaves, shielding private keys within a protective walnut shell of silicon. Reaching the consensus summit requires valid cryptographic quotes, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable capital cost of dedicated hardware per persona rather than cloning bots across a digital tundra. However, relying on centralized chipmakers exposes the system to supply-chain risks and side-channel leakage.
